metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from Agulhas Labs. Delegate: a team of agents sized to the job, and a report of where your tokens went. Cache Guard: a warning before the one message that costs twenty times the rest. Logbook: a live local page for a long task, and its report when the task ends. Upkeep: a reminder every two weeks to look after your Claude Code setup, and the checks to do it.

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: Your Claude Code session leads a team of agents, each on the cheapest model that can do its job. Work isn't accepted until a command proves it, and a built-in report shows where your tokens went.
plugins.displayName: Delegate: Agents Sized to the Job

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Warns once before a message that will cost far more than usual: a large Claude Code context whose prompt cache has expired, or a model or effort change that resets it. Shows the estimated cost, and offers a handoff file written by a cheap model in the background so you can /clear instead.

plugins.name: logbook
plugins.description: Keeps a live local page for a long Claude Code task: what needs you, what was built, what was verified, and what was decided without you. Hooks record it without spending model tokens, the page follows light, dark or your system's setting, and when the task ends the same page is the report.

plugins.name: upkeep
plugins.description: Reminds you every two weeks to look after your Claude Code setup, and /upkeep runs the checks: what /doctor reports, plus rules and skills that are too big, installed guides that have drifted from their source, and leftover worktrees, branches and stale memory. It proposes; nothing changes without your confirmation.
